name: Mayor
guide:
**Rules reminder:**
• If only 3 players live and no execution occurs, your team wins.
• If you die at night, another player might die instead.
• You are a Townsfolk character.
winPreamble: 🎖️ **{player}** (Mayor) invokes their power — **GOOD WINS!** Only 3 remain and no one was executed.
winAnnouncement: 🌟 **GOOD WINS!** The Demon has been slain. The town is saved!
